summary: No change: submission.json carries only a rationale and adds no sources, investigations, knowledge, gaps, interpretations or experiment; the bytes validate with no diagnostics. The run's record is complete for this session - every question is explained with a retained receipt where the answer was measured and an explicit source-only basis where it was not, no necessary gap is open, no execution lacks an interpretation, and the retained findings, counterevidence and sourced Behaviour entries cover the mechanisms a reviewer needs. With the budget expiring in this turn, a further experiment could not receive the interpretation that makes it a conclusion and more sourced entries would repeat recorded code, so the update stays unchanged; expiry preserves the retained evidence and needs no closing call, leaving defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication to human offline review.
